text: The footer’s disabled property affects forward and visible custom actions, while toggleBackDisabled is a separate operation. Email abortable changes the back button’s text to Cancel and keeps it available during a cancellable operation. Callers can independently use toggleBackDisabled for a different loading contract. Therefore this is a footer default and email cancellation contract, not a rule that Back must always remain enabled in every Account Hub view. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep cancellation separate from the footer’s disabled property
